critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: /app/backend/routers/driver.py::depart (line 447) — 'r.get("passeggero", {}).get("tel")' crashed with AttributeError when the field is stored as None (doc explicitly sets 'passeggero': None when no passeggero_nome is provided at creation, line 278). The .get(key, default) only returns default when key is MISSING, not when the stored value is None. Fixed to '(r.get("passeggero") or {}).get("tel")'. Recommend main agent apply the same defensive pattern to any similar chained access on optional-nullable fields (spot-check: r.get('pagamento').get(...) at line 558 is safe because pagamento is always initialised as dict).

rca_of_issue: RCA (1 bug found and fixed): POST /api/driver/richieste/{rid}/depart returned 500 with `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get'` for any richiesta created without a passeggero_nome. Reproduction: create richiesta with default payload (no passeggero_nome) → confirm → depart → 500. Root cause: create_richiesta stores `passeggero: {...} if body.passeggero_nome else None` (routers/driver.py:278), so the field is present with value None. depart() used `r.get('passeggero', {}).get('tel')` which returns None (not the default {}) when the key exists with value None, then chained .get('tel') crashes. Mitigation applied: replaced with `(r.get('passeggero') or {}).get('tel')` on line 447. Verified: after fix, both NCC depart and TAXI depart complete 200 and full lifecycles finish (all 26 tests green).
